org_units_kind_parent_check.name: org_units_kind_parent_check
org_units_kind_parent_check.value: ("org_units"."kind" = 'department' and "org_units"."parent_id" is null) or ("org_units"."kind" = 'section' and "org_units"."parent_id" is not null)

modules_common_check.name: modules_common_check
modules_common_check.value: ("modules"."owner_org_unit_id" is null) = ("modules"."common_target" is not null) and ("modules"."card_position_id" is null or "modules"."owner_org_unit_id" is not null)

assignment_items_kind_check.name: assignment_items_kind_check
assignment_items_kind_check.value: ("assignment_items"."kind" = 'content' and "assignment_items"."content_version_id" is not null) or ("assignment_items"."kind" = 'card_section' and "assignment_items"."card_version_id" is not null and "assignment_items"."section_key" is not null)

visits_host_check.name: visits_host_check
visits_host_check.value: "visits"."host_user_id" is not null or "visits"."host_name_text" is not null
